newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond sells telecom subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond sells telecom subsidiary.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said Thursday that it has signed an agreement to sell its telecommunications subsidiary, North American InTeleCom Inc, for an undisclosed sum.
Telserve Communication Inc of Richardson, Texas, will buy North American InTeleCom's common stock and pay cash for 80 percent of the purchase price, Ultramar said.
The remainder will be paid in preferred stock, the company said.
Ultramar said the deal should close December 31.
The company said the sale fits with its previously announced plan to sell about $100 million in non-strategic assets during 1996.
